summary: Read music scores with setlists and half-page turns.
page_description: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.
release_notes: Music libraries, setlists, and their scores now page to fit the reader. Navigation and collection controls stay reachable, and Back returns through the collection views.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Create the score shelf on the reader.
Send a PDF score or a folder of page images.
